title: Guns N' Mushrooms
description: The  official Modpack for the Guns N' Mushrooms Minecraft server.
body:
# 🌲🔫 Guns N' Mushrooms 🍄✈️

A survival sandbox where bullets echo through biomes and mushrooms grow in the shadow of war machines.

Guns N' Mushrooms blends tactical firepower, immersive exploration, and fantasy dimensions into one chaotic, beautiful Forge adventure.

Whether you’re flying over towering forests, diving into corrupted depths, or stumbling into a forgotten temple with a rifle in hand, this pack is built for players who want danger, discovery, and just a little madness.

## 💥 Combat & Firepower

Armed survival takes center stage with modern and experimental weapons:

Timeless and Classics Zero (TACZ) for realistic guns

Addon packs for even more firepower

Tactical combat that makes every encounter feel personal

No more slap-fighting zombies. This world bites back.

## 🌍 World Generation on Overdrive

Explore a world that refuses to be boring:

Terralith & Biomes O’ Plenty create massive, diverse landscapes

Dynamic Trees brings forests to life

YUNG’s Better Structures overhaul dungeons, temples, mineshafts, and more

Structory Towers, Bridges, and Extras make every journey cinematic

You’re not just exploring a map. You’re trespassing in a masterpiece.

## 🌌 Dimensions & Depths

When the Overworld isn’t strange enough:

The Aether lets you rise into skybound realms

Deeper and Darker drags you into terrifying ancient depths

Nullscape & Incendium reshape the End and Nether into alien nightmares

Each dimension feels handcrafted and hostile in the best way.

## ✈️ Mobility & Adventure

Immersive Aircraft & Warfare Wings turn the skies into your highway

Fly, scout, dogfight, or just vibe above the chaos below

## ⚙️ Performance & QoL

Smooth, stable, and ready for long sessions:

Embeddium, FerriteCore, REI, Waystones

Carefully tuned for performance without sacrificing visuals or scale

## 🎯 Perfect For:

✔️ Exploration junkies
✔️ Gunplay enjoyers
✔️ Survival players who want danger
✔️ Builders who love dramatic landscapes
✔️ Friends who want chaos together

## ⚠️ Warning

This modpack may cause:

Spontaneous base destruction

“One more dungeon” syndrome

An unhealthy love for flying over biomes at sunset
